name: Image Classification
description: Supervised land cover classification of raster layers: pick any bands and spectral indices, draw point, polygon, circle or rectangle training samples on the map with a live spectral profile per class, train Random Forest, Gradient Tree Boost or SVM with a training/testing split, and get overall accuracy, kappa, a confusion matrix, class areas and a classified GeoTIFF.
author: Defani Arman Alfitriansyah
